burn(address).custom:error: Throw UserHasNoPrimeToken if user has no prime tokenThrow ScoreUpdateInProgress if a score update round is active

burnBatch(address[]).custom:error: Throw ScoreUpdateInProgress if a score update round is active
burnBatch(address[]).custom:event: Emits Burn event for each user

claimInterest(address).custom:error: Throw MarketNotSupported if market is not supported

claimInterest(address,address).custom:error: Throw MarketNotSupported if market is not supported
claimInterest(address,address).details: Permissionless: anyone can trigger a claim on behalf of a user.      Tokens are always sent to the user address, never to msg.sender.

claimPrime(address).custom:error: Throw ScoreUpdateInProgress if a score update round is activeThrow UserAlreadyHasPrimeToken if user already has a tokenThrow LeaderboardNotSet if primeLeaderboard address is not configuredThrow MintThresholdNotSet if mintThreshold is zeroThrow EligibilityBelowThreshold if user's effective stake < mintThresholdThrow InvalidLimit if mint limit would be exceededThrow MintWindowClosed if the minting deadline has passed
claimPrime(address).custom:event: Emits Mint event on new token issuance
claimPrime(address).details: Checks user's effective stake from PrimeLeaderboard against mintThreshold.      Anyone can call this on behalf of an eligible user. No ACM required.      mintThreshold must be set by governance after each epoch before this is usable.

claimPrimeBatch(address[]).custom:error: Throw ScoreUpdateInProgress if a score update round is activeThrow LeaderboardNotSet if primeLeaderboard address is not configuredThrow MintThresholdNotSet if mintThreshold is zeroThrow MintWindowClosed if the minting deadline has passedThrow InvalidLimit if mint limit would be exceeded
claimPrimeBatch(address[]).custom:event: Emits Mint event for each new token issuanceEmits SkippedIneligibleUser for each non-holder below threshold
claimPrimeBatch(address[]).details: Non-holders below mintThreshold are skipped with a SkippedIneligibleUser event      (not reverted), so one ineligible user cannot block the rest of the batch.      Existing Prime holders are silently skipped. Anyone can call this. No ACM required.

params.users: Array of user addresses to mint for

getBlockNumberOrTimestamp().details: Function to simply retrieve block number or block timestamp

returns._0: Current block number or block timestamp

returns.pendingRewards: Array of pending rewards per market

getPendingRewardsStatic(address).details: Returns rewards based on last accrued state without triggering new accrual

returns.pendingRewards: Array of pending rewards per market

initialize(uint128,uint128,address,addre.custom:error: Throw InvalidAddress if any of the address is zeroThrow InvalidAlphaArguments if alpha arguments are invalid

params.alphaDenominator_: Denominator of alpha (if alpha is 0.5 then denominator is 2)
params.alphaNumerator_: Numerator of alpha (if alpha is 0.5 then numerator is 1)
params.loopsLimit_: Maximum number of loops allowed in a single transaction

returns._0: exists Whether user has Prime token

issue(address).custom:error: Throw InvalidAddress if user is zero addressThrow InvalidLimit if mint limit would be exceededThrow UserAlreadyHasPrimeToken if user already has a tokenThrow ScoreUpdateInProgress if a score update round is active
issue(address).custom:event: Emits Mint event on new token issuance

issueBatch(address[]).custom:error: Throw InvalidAddress if any user in the batch is zero addressThrow InvalidLimit if mint limit would be exceededThrow ScoreUpdateInProgress if a score update round is active
issueBatch(address[]).custom:event: Emits Mint event on new token issuance

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

removeMarket(address).custom:error: Throw MarketNotSupported if market doesn't existThrow MarketHasActiveMembers if market still has members with scores

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAccessControlManager(address).details: Admin function to set address of AccessControlManager

params.accessControlManager_: The new address of the AccessControlManager

setLimit(uint256).custom:error: Throw InvalidLimit if limit is less than current count

setMintThreshold(uint256,uint256).custom:error: Throw InvalidDeadline if mintDeadline_ is non-zero and not strictly in the future
setMintThreshold(uint256,uint256).details: Governance calls this after each epoch. Pass mintThreshold_ = 0 to disable the permissionless      minting window immediately. Pass mintDeadline_ = 0 for no expiry.      The window auto-closes once block.timestamp exceeds mintDeadline_.

params.mintDeadline_: Unix timestamp after which minting is closed (0 = no deadline)
params.mintThreshold_: New mint threshold (set to 0 to close the window)

setPrimeLeaderboard(address).custom:error: Throw InvalidAddress if address is zero

sweepUndistributed(address,address).custom:error: Throw MarketNotSupported if vToken is not a Prime marketThrow InvalidAddress if to is the zero address
sweepUndistributed(address,address).custom:event: Emits UndistributedSwept on a non-zero transfer
sweepUndistributed(address,address).details: Flushes any pending PLP delta via accrueInterest first so the      slice is fully captured in undistributedReward, then pulls funds      from PrimeLiquidityProvider when Prime's local balance is short,      mirroring the _claimInterest pattern (delete unreleasedPLPIncome      then call releaseFunds, both sides reset atomically).

params.vToken: Market address whose underlying slice should be swept

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

updateAlpha(uint128,uint128).custom:error: Throw InvalidAlphaArguments if alpha arguments are invalid

updateMultipliers(address,uint256,uint25.custom:error: Throw MarketNotSupported if market is not supportedThrow InvalidMultipliers if both multipliers are zero

updateScores(address[]).custom:error: Throw NoScoreUpdatesRequired if no score updates are required
updateScores(address[]).details: Intentionally not gated by whenNotPaused — keeper must complete rounds even during pauses
